meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude 能编写 Python 代码查询 CZ CELLxgene Census 的公开单细胞与空间转录组数据，包括细胞元数据、基因表达矩阵、摘要计数、H5AD 下载等，并支持大规模及机器学习处理。
howto.when: 当用户需要查询公开单细胞或空间转录组数据，如按组织、疾病、细胞类型筛选时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下人类肺组织中 B 细胞的基因表达。
用 cellxgene-census 获取 COVID-19 患者的细胞元数据。
计算小鼠脑中 FOXP2 基因的平均表达量。
say.note: 将使用 axis_query 做增量统计。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can write Python code to query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data from the CZ CELLxgene Census, including cell metadata, gene expression matrices, summary counts, H5AD downloads, and support large-scale and machine learning processing.
howto.when_en: Trigger when users need to query public single-cell or spatial transcriptomics data, such as filtering by tissue, disease, or cell type.

say_en.text: Help me query gene expression of B cells in human lung tissue.
say_en.note: Claude will call the Census API and return an AnnData object.

say_en.text: Use cellxgene-census to get cell metadata for COVID-19 patients.
say_en.note: It will run a get_obs query.

say_en.text: Compute mean expression of FOXP2 in mouse brain.
say_en.note: It will use axis_query for incremental statistics.
